# Dayloop v0.12.0-rc12

This candidate turns the P5R Palace route into a more complete, checkable game companion.

- Adds the April 15 money and crafting-material grind target, including the ¥19,100 example and the safe farming cutoff.
- Splits Palace captures, Will Seeds, puzzle gates, route goals, fusion objectives, carry-out Personas, and grind targets into dated tasks.
- Adds pack-themed **Tips** actions to relevant tasks for combat, farming, and navigation guidance without crowding the checklist.
- Makes task tips searchable from the pack search screen.
- Adds content and schema audits so guide objectives remain checkable and blank tips cannot ship.
